scientific_contract: Independent Assumption Sensitivity reread. Inspect the shared paper and Lead Reader draft, but do not read other Lens outputs. Return corrections/additions, not a competing full summary.
description: Reader v3 independent specialist pass: Assumption Sensitivity.
instructions:
Role: Assumption Sensitivity.
Answer only this role's scientific questions. Cite source evidence IDs/pages for every material finding.
- Which assumptions are load-bearing?
- Which conclusions fail or weaken if an assumption changes?
- Which assumptions are tested versus merely asserted?
Cross-cutting checks: record a real anomaly when relevant; test a serious counterfactual/alternative explanation when relevant. Do not force either when the evidence does not support one. Use action KEEP/EXPAND/CORRECT/QUALIFY/VERIFY/NONE to tell the later editor how the Lead Reader draft should change.
